description: Check whether an MCP server or API is safe to connect to, BEFORE connecting. Returns a letter grade (A+ to F), the verification state, and any findings — hidden instructions, exposed secrets, unsafe defaults. Accepts full URLs or bare hosts like mcp.example.com/mcp.

kind.description: Optional hint: mcp = MCP endpoint, api = API base URL, auto = detect

target.description: The MCP endpoint or API base URL to check (e.g. https://mcp.example.com/mcp)

name: check_tool
